name: livecheck
description: Agents waste tokens and context fetching job and product pages that are already closed, sold out, or 404, then hand the user a dead link. Livecheck checks the primary source first and returns live, closed, or unknown plus signals. Not a search engine. Payment is x402: $0.01 USDC on Base via Stripe. The Cursor MCP surfaces the HTTP 402; a wallet agent completes payment.
